# S62 — Resolve release permission gate for AndroidX signature permission

**Findings:** S22 signed minified APK aapt2 dump permissions declares and requests com.squalor.consecutor.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION in addition to the two allowed permissions. · **Size:** S · **Tree:** release

**2026-10-05** — Score 3/3/1: the literal release-permission gate fails on the signed APK; resolving the AndroidX signature-protection requirement versus the accepted gate is a small, required release decision.

Resolve the permission gate observed by S22. No release tagging or unrelated manifest changes.

## Why

S22 requires exactly POST_NOTIFICATIONS and RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED. The verified minified release additionally requests the app-scoped DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION. The literal gate fails; its intended treatment must be resolved without weakening receiver protection.

## Files

app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml; merged release manifest; S22 permission acceptance criterion and DEVELOPERS.md.

## Failing tests

aapt2 dump permissions on the S22 locally signed release lists three uses-permission entries instead of the specified two. Evidence: build/s22-validation/apk-permissions.txt.

## Implement

1. Trace the extra permission to its manifest contribution and verify its protection level and receiver use.
2. Agree with the owner whether the gate should exclude an app-scoped signature permission or the merged manifest must change. Do not remove receiver protection to satisfy a count.
3. Apply the agreed bounded change and rerun the release permission and receiver checks.

## Check

The merged, minified signed APK matches the agreed permission gate; receiver security behavior is preserved; PRIVACY.md matches.
